details.question: What did DarGlobal announce about Jeddah in November 2026?
details.answer: According to DarGlobal, on 16 November 2026 the company announced a new Jeddah development valued at SAR 1 billion, expanding its Saudi Arabia portfolio [1][2]. CEO Ziad El Chaar said Saudi Arabia remains one of Dar Global’s most vital growth markets, noted Jeddah’s exceptional fundamentals, and mentioned that buyers from 61 nationalities are already investing in its Saudi portfolio [2]. Further details on the architectural concept, residential offerings, and official launch date will be unveiled later [2].

details.question: Where is Tierra Viva located?
details.answer: Tierra Viva is located in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, Spain, on the Costa Del Sol [1][2]. It is about 15 minutes from Marbella, within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande, minutes from the Mediterranean shores, and close to 12 golf clubs and Andalusian villages [1][2].
